title: Kitchen towel roll holder (dimension research)
prompt: Model a wall-mounted holder for a roll of kitchen paper towel, for FDM printing. It screws to the wall with two screws and the roll slides onto a horizontal arm. The roll must actually fit — work out what size a kitchen towel roll is before you size anything, state the numbers and where they came from, and say which size variant you designed for. Drive the roll clearance from a Parameters spreadsheet so it can be adjusted. Report which screws the user needs to buy.

dimensions.name: fits_the_largest_common_roll
dimensions.comment: THE point of this task. A kitchen roll is 230 mm in Czechia, 260 mm in Germany and 279 mm (11 in) in the US, so anything designed around a guessed 250 mm fits neither of the larger two. The holder's longest dimension must clear the largest common roll plus clearance and its own walls; 285 mm is the floor, not a target. Measured on the bounding box because the roll axis can be modelled along any axis.

parametric_probe.comment: the clearance must be a real driving parameter, not a number buried in a sketch

functional.comment: A holder is only a holder if the thing goes into it. The dimension check above is the real test; these confirm it is a mountable part and not a decorative slab.
